units.source_text: 忽地，无色模糊的线条勾勒出门的轮廓，浮了出来。

en.t: Suddenly, colorless, blurred lines traced the outline of the door, and it emerged.

units.source_text: 就像薄羽蜉蝣的翅膀，散发出细碎淡光。

en.t: Like the wings of a thin-winged mayfly, it gave off a fine, faint light.

units.source_text: 眼睛渐渐习惯了，沙子擂钵的底部，整个就如黏性强的嫩芽肌肤，现出了柔润的光泽……

en.t: As his eyes gradually grew accustomed to it, the whole bottom of the mortar-shaped hollow of sand took on a soft, moist sheen, like the skin of a tender, sticky shoot...
